scenario.name: r-cw-5-cost-cap-reject
scenario.description: Cost-cap exhaustion requires an isolated config-mutation fixture that lowers costCapTokens, observes the dispatch rejection, and restores state.
scenario.registryNotes: The scaffold intentionally cannot run until an explicitly authorized fixture implements backup/lower/fire/restore receipts.

expectedReceipts.name: seat-readiness-continuation-enabled
expectedReceipts.description: Precursor receipt proves continuation defaults before fixture mutation.

expectedReceipts.name: original-config-captured
expectedReceipts.description: The original costCapTokens value is retained for restoration.

expectedReceipts.name: failure-safe-restore-armed
expectedReceipts.description: A restore guard is armed before mutation.

expectedReceipts.name: config-lowered
expectedReceipts.description: The fixture records its row-local low cap.

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoke-rejected
expectedReceipts.description: continue_work rejects at the exhausted cost cap.

expectedReceipts.name: config-restored
expectedReceipts.description: The original cap is restored even after failure.

review.notes: This is the live cap-exhaustion claim. It is not proven by static checks.

liveRunSafety.notes: Fail closed until a separately authorized disposable fixture captures the complete mutation and restoration chain.
